svg.title: Processing PII with Presidio: build, deploy and run on AWS
svg.desc: Harness builds the repository Dockerfile into one image with the .NET worker, CPython, Presidio and the spaCy model, pushes it to Amazon ECR and deploys it to an ECS Fargate service. The task reads each feed's Solace input queue over the native client, masks known PII inside the process, publishes to the feed's protected topic, and acknowledges the input only after the broker confirms. Rejected or repeatedly failing input goes to the feed's dead letter queue. The Solace password comes from Secrets Manager at task start.
svg.text: Processing PII with Presidio · build, deploy and run on AWS
Proposed Dev deployment: code becomes one Docker image, Harness deploys it to ECS, and the worker processes Solace messages. Amber items need the team's input.

Task pulls the image

How it works
Harness builds the Dockerfile into one image holding the .NET worker,
CPython, Presidio and the spaCy model, pushes it to ECR and points the
ECS service at it. The task reads each feed's input queue through the
native Solace client, masks known PII inside the process and publishes
to the feed's topic. It acks the input only after the broker confirms.
Rejected or repeatedly failing input goes to the feed's DLQ, never to
output. Unacknowledged input stays on the broker for redelivery.
Solace details still needed
· Seats and PNR-Linking input queues for Dev
· Output queue, topic subscription and consumer per feed
· One DLQ per feed, restricted like its input queue
· ACL: consume inputs, publish topics, send to DLQs
· Delivery count on; queue max redelivery above 5
· Broker CA certificate, unless it is a public CA
· Network path and firewall rule from the ECS subnets
· A unique client name for each running task
Solace password at runtime
The secret piidemo/dev/solace holds the key password. The task
definition maps it to SOLACE_PASSWORD, the variable the worker
already reads. ECS fetches it when the task starts, so the worker
needs no code change and makes no AWS call.
Access: execution role gets secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on this
secret only, plus kms:Decrypt if a customer KMS key encrypts it.
Rotation: update the secret, then restart the task.
